rationale: The interpreter omitted the ticket clause that explicitly limits scope by stating that no other behavior is in scope. This missing requirement could lead implementers to add functionality beyond the intended scope.

findings.description: The interpreter does not capture the ticket statement that no other behavior is in scope.
findings.action: Add the scope limitation statement to the interpretation, e.g., include a business rule or note that no other behavior is in scope.
